import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
tsv=S.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?query=xref:panther-PTHR13651'
          '&fields=accession,organism_name,sequence&format=tsv',timeout=180).text
L=[l.split('\t') for l in tsv.strip().split('\n')]; hdr=L[0]
recs=[dict(zip(hdr,r)) for r in L[1:]]
MOUSE=[r['Sequence'] for r in recs if r['Entry']=='Q80ZQ9'][0]
pool={}
for r in recs:
    s=r['Sequence']
    if r['Entry']=='Q80ZQ9' or not (150<len(s)<400): continue
    pool.setdefault(s, r['Organism'])            # dedupe identical sequences
items=sorted(pool.items())
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
sel=[items[i] for i in rng.choice(len(items), size=min(400,len(items)), replace=False)]
print(f"{len(recs)} PTHR13651 entries -> {len(items)} unique seqs -> {len(sel)} sampled; mouse len={len(MOUSE)}")

bl="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3

0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2

-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2

0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -2 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rr=bl.split('\n'); AA=rr[0].split()
SUB=np.full((128,128),-4.0)
for a,row in zip(AA,rr[1:]):
    for b,v in zip(AA,row.split()): SUB[ord(a),ord(b)]=float(v)
mo=np.frombuffer(MOUSE.encode(),dtype=np.uint8); n=len(MOUSE); G=-8.0
NEG=-1e9

def nw_diag(b):
    """global NW, linear gap, anti-diagonal vectorised; returns mouse-anchored column chars"""
    bo=np.frombuffer(b.encode(),dtype=np.uint8); m=len(b)
    Sm=SUB[np.ix_(mo,bo)]
    H=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    H[0,:]=G*np.arange(m+1); H[:,0]=G*np.arange(n+1)
    P[0,1:]=2; P[1:,0]=1; P[0,0]=3
    for d in range(2,n+m+1):
        i=np.arange(max(1,d-m),min(n,d-1)+1)
        if not len(i): continue
        j=d-i
        cand=np.stack([H[i-1,j-1]+Sm[i-1,j-1], H[i-1,j]+G, H[i,j-1]+G])
        k=np.argmax(cand,0)
        H[i,j]=cand[k,np.arange(len(i))]; P[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; col=np.full(n,'-',dtype='<U1')
    while i>0 and j>0:
        k=P[i,j]
        if k==0: col[i-1]=b[j-1]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif k==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return col

PATCH=[96,99,128,130,161]; POS=sorted(set(PATCH+[98,30,31,54,55,117]))
LBL={p:('basic patch' if p in PATCH else 'GKxK[KR]G loop' if p==98
        else 'patch A (iter 1)' if p in (30,31,54,55) else 'GcvH lipoyl-Lys site') for p in POS}
cols={p:[] for p in POS}
for s,org in sel:
    c=nw_diag(s)
    for p in POS: cols[p].append(c[p-1])
print(f"aligned {len(sel)} orthologs")

out=[]
for p in POS:
    v=pd.Series(cols[p]); top=v.value_counts().head(3)
    out.append({'pos':p,'mouse_aa':MOUSE[p-1],
                'pct_identical':round(100*(v==MOUSE[p-1]).mean(),1),
                'pct_K_or_R':round(100*v.isin(list('KR')).mean(),1),
                'pct_gap':round(100*(v=='-').mean(),1),
                'top3':"; ".join(f"{a}:{c}" for a,c in top.items()),'site':LBL[p]})
df=pd.DataFrame(out); pd.set_option('display.width',200)
print(); print(df.to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv('/agent/jobs/7fa3ef47-758c-4d83-8be4-ef31af2ced2a/provenance/patch_conservation.csv',index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5,4.8))
x=np.arange(len(df)); ax.bar(x-0.2,df.pct_identical,0.4,label='identical to mouse',color='#4878a8')
ax.bar(x+0.2,df.pct_K_or_R,0.4,label='Lys or Arg',color='#c44e52')
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{r.mouse_aa}{r.pos}" for r in df.itertuples()])
for i,r in enumerate(df.itertuples()): ax.text(i,102,r.site,rotation=90,ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylim(0,170); ax.set_ylabel(f'% of {len(sel)} orthologs'); ax.legend(loc='upper right',fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('Conservation of candidate surface residues, PANTHER PTHR13651 orthologs')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
